instruction: Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.

target.reason: The instruction wants Glitch to plug the data shard into his deck and crack its contents, but the page offers no verb for using or cracking an item - only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse. None of the available end states (holding the shard, being somewhere, saying something, or knowing a location/holder) captures plugging in and cracking the shard; even getting Glitch to hold or be offered the data-shard would not amount to using it.
